label: joining with aur
note: Closed by HI-C68-aur (chapter 68), and taught GLOSS-FIRST for the reason this note used to record as a blocker: `aur` opens on the independent vowel au, which no writing lesson has ever drawn and which the corpus shows exactly once, inside `aurat`. Its Devanagari therefore appears only in the headword, where the romanization exemption makes it exposure; the body is entirely romanized and says in as many words that the letter is owed. The word is far too load-bearing to wait for a script lesson -- it carries a clause join in five of the six mock profile texts -- and the debt is recorded rather than hidden.
